chunks: And seek forgiveness of your Lord, then turn to Him. Indeed, my Lord is Compassionate and Loving.
ai.seo_question: What is the relationship between seeking forgiveness and repentance in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to illustrate the seamless transition from seeking pardon to sincere repentance, grounded in the divine attributes of Rahim (Merciful) and Wadud (Loving). It underscores that God's readiness to forgive is not merely a legal absolution but an affectionate invitation for believers to return to their Creator, reinforcing the concept of divine closeness in the process of spiritual purification.
